C0014.title: Merchant Sentenced for Defrauding Government-Issued Consumer Vouchers
C0014.summary: In early 2023, a district in Shenzhen launched a promotional campaign issuing consumer vouchers. Xu, the legal representative of Company A, operated a swimming pool that participated in the campaign and fraudulently obtained voucher subsidies through fictitious transactions. This involved using voucher codes to fabricate transactions to steal government subsidies.
